```sql
WITH order_costs AS (
  SELECT order_id, order_cost
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
),
revenue_cte AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(product_price) AS revenue
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items"
  WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT
  SUM(r.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost) AS gross_profit_2025,
  (SUM(r.revenue) - SUM(o.order_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(r.revenue), 0) AS gross_margin_pct_2025
FROM revenue_cte r
JOIN order_costs o ON r.order_id = o.order_id;
```
